title: Hoofprints of the Past Museum

services.name: Cabin stay
services.desc: In honor of America’s 250th Anniversary Celebration in 2026, Hoofprints of the Past Museum erected a Wyoming State Historical marker overlooking the KC Ranch Battle site which is located in the town of Kaycee. Annually in August, the museum conducts a Johnson County War historical tour which includes a detailed history of this site and other sites related to the war. The KC Cabin Gunfight site is where, in 1892, a vigilante group of the Wyoming Stockgrowers Association, surrounded a cabin where local rancher, Nathan D. Champion was staying.
